title: What If All the Antarctic Krill Vanished?

scenes.text: What if krill vanished? Blue whales eat four tons of them a day.
Krill together weigh 300 to 500 million tonnes, the most of any wild animal.
A blue whale eats about four tons a day, roughly the weight of a hippo.
Penguins, seals, seabirds and fish all hunt krill too. The food web would lose its base.
A 2020 study linked heavy krill fishing near the South Shetland Islands to slower penguin foraging and fewer healthy chicks.
People already catch about 450,000 tonnes a year. Remove it all, and the Southern Ocean loses its foundation.
